title: CALM C4 Mapping
description: Maps CALM node types to C4 kinds, so that tools show the C4 model of an architecture in the same way. A node type that no mapping names gets its kind from the structural rules in the README of this standard.

$schema.description: The schema of this document, for example https://calm.finos.org/standards/c4/1.0/c4-mapping.json

$id.description: The URL where the mapping is published, for a mapping that other mappings extend

extends.description: The URL of the mapping that this mapping extends, usually https://calm.finos.org/standards/c4/1.0/calm-default.c4-mapping.json. The entries of this mapping replace the entries of that mapping. A mapping with no extends replaces the default mapping

node-types.description: A map from a CALM node-type to its C4 kind

external.description: When true, every node of this type is outside the enterprise. Permitted only with the kinds person, software-system, container and component

nesting.description: What a tool does when a mapped node is at the level of its parent or above it. demote: the node shows one level below its parent, so a container inside a container shows as a component. strict: the node keeps its mapped kind and the tool reports a conflict. A mapping that does not set nesting uses the nesting of the mapping it extends. When no mapping in the chain sets it, nesting is demote

kind.description: A C4 kind. See the README of this standard for the meaning of each kind
